# Marketplace Intellectual Property Evidence

Marketplace respects intellectual property rights and accepts a complaint from rights owners or authorized agents.

## Trademark Infringement

A listing may create trademark infringement concerns when it uses a protected brand name, logo, or confusingly similar mark without authorization. Marketplace may remove listings that infringe trademarks.

## Counterfeit Listings

Counterfeit goods are prohibited. Sellers must not offer products that imitate branded goods or misuse registered marks.

## Enforcement and Removal

Marketplace may take enforcement action including listing removal when a complaint includes evidence of intellectual property infringement.

## Appeal Process

A seller may submit an appeal with authorization documents, invoices, or other evidence showing that the listing is lawful.
